stages.name: Onboarding
stages.description: Complete your seller profile, sign the Form 6 appointment and secure your pre-sale finance facility.

gateConditions.description: Form 6 (Appointment of Agent) signed by seller and countersigned by platform
Pre-sale finance facility approved by ListReady
Seller confirms all onboarding information is correct

actionText.seller: Sign your Form 6 and complete your finance application to get started
actionText.agent: Awaiting seller onboarding — you will be matched once complete
actionText.platform_admin: Review Form 6 countersign and finance approval

stages.name: Agent Assignment
stages.description: The platform matches and assigns your dedicated agent. Your agent signs the conjunction agreement and introduces themselves.

gateConditions.description: Conjunction agreement signed by agent and platform
Agent introduction call or visit completed and noted
Seller approves the assigned agent and is ready to proceed

actionText.seller: Review your matched agent and confirm you're ready to proceed
actionText.agent: Sign your conjunction agreement and schedule your property introduction
actionText.platform_admin: Match and assign agent; confirm introduction is complete

stages.name: Property Preparation
stages.description: Complete all pre-market improvements — repairs, cleaning, styling, and professional photography — to maximise appeal.

gateConditions.description: All approved improvements completed and signed off by agent
Professional photography delivered and approved
Seller approves property is ready for marketing

actionText.seller: Approve quotes and coordinate access for tradespeople and photographers
actionText.agent: Coordinate all preparation works and confirm completion

stages.name: Off-Market Campaign
stages.description: Before going public, your property is matched to qualified buyers in the platform database. Sell fast with no marketing costs.

gateConditions.description: Off-market buyer matching run and alerts sent
Off-market inspection period completed (minimum 7 days)
Seller reviews off-market results and decides whether to accept offer or proceed to on-market

actionText.seller: Review off-market interest and decide whether to accept an offer or proceed to public listing
actionText.agent: Run buyer matching, schedule inspections, and report results to seller
actionText.platform_admin: Monitor off-market campaign and validate inspection records

stages.name: Public Listing
stages.description: Your property goes live on Domain and REA. Open homes, buyer enquiries, and active marketing campaign.

gateConditions.description: Property listed on Domain and REA
Open home schedule confirmed and communicated
Seller confirms they are ready to consider offers

actionText.seller: Review listing and approve it going live on Domain and REA
actionText.agent: Publish listing, schedule open homes, manage buyer enquiries
actionText.platform_admin: Validate listing quality and approve publication

stages.name: Offers & Contracts
stages.description: Review offers, negotiate, and execute the Sale Contract. Cooling-off period begins upon signing.

gateConditions.description: Offer formally accepted and Sale Contract sent for signing
Sale Contract signed by buyer and seller via DocuSign
Seller countersigns and approves the executed contract

actionText.seller: Review offers with your agent and countersign the accepted contract
actionText.agent: Present all offers, negotiate on seller's behalf, prepare contract
actionText.platform_admin: Validate contract execution and initiate cooling-off tracking

stages.name: Settlement
stages.description: Final settlement — transfer of title, release of deposit, repayment of finance facility, and distribution of proceeds.

gateConditions.description: Settlement date confirmed with all parties and conveyancers
Settlement funds confirmed and reconciliation processed by platform
Seller confirms receipt of net proceeds

actionText.seller: Confirm settlement details with your conveyancer and await net proceeds
actionText.agent: Coordinate with all parties to confirm settlement date
actionText.platform_admin: Process settlement reconciliation and distribute proceeds
